_about: Pagouro BE key facts. Every number traces to a file in this folder (evals/, ledger/, CORPUS.md). null = not yet measured.
name: Pagouro BE
type: Offline text-to-image model in the Paris lithographic poster style of 1890-1910, on a USB stick

base_model.name: CommonCanvas-S-C
base_model.architecture: Stable Diffusion 2 (UNet 865.9M params, OpenCLIP text encoder 340.4M), 512 px, epsilon prediction
base_model.training_data: CommonCatalog: CC-BY and CC-BY-SA images from YFCC100M (Flickr uploads 2004-2014), machine captions (BLIP-2)

our_corpus.date_basis: every image made before 1929; base model photographs uploaded before 2015
our_corpus.captions: one content sentence per image, machine-written (google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, 2026-09-29), labelled in the ledger
our_corpus.ledger: ledger/ (per-image rows with source, id, title, artist, date, rights as found, sha256)

training.shipped: round 3 (centre crops only, lettering-free images x2, 4,000 steps from round 2)

runtime.note: q8_0 quantisation of this checkpoint produced blank images on CPU (evals/round3/); the f16 file ships

what_it_is_not: not a frontier image model; draws lettering on most pictures whether asked or not, and the lettering is not readable; no image input; no text output
